_comment: Mid-session settings contract (D48 S4), generated from the codex binary itself:
Same provenance as codex-method-contract.json (METHOD names) and
codex-turn-schema.json (turn PARAM shapes); this file pins the shapes the
zero-turn permission channel sends and reads back.
It exists because thread/settings/update accepts UNKNOWN FIELDS SILENTLY
[实测 06-probes P1 严格性观察: unknown key -> {} , no notification, no effect],
so a misspelled field is invisible at runtime AND in any test that only checks
'the request was accepted'. The parameter builder is whitelist-only and this
snapshot is what the whitelist is pinned against.
SandboxPolicy is the one shape that must never be copied from thread/start:
thread/start takes `sandbox` as a kebab-case STRING (read-only /
thread/settings/update take `sandboxPolicy` as a camelCase discriminated
OBJECT. Three call sites, two spellings [实测 06-probes §0.2].
2026-08-26 UPGRADE 0.145.0 -> 0.149.1: re-generated against the newly pinned
binary and every block below came out IDENTICAL -- ThreadSettingsUpdateParams
ThreadSettingsUpdatedNotification. The stamp moved, the contract did not.

ThreadSettingsUpdateParams.permissionsDescription: Select a named permissions profile id for subsequent turns. Cannot be combined with `sandboxPolicy`.
